title: Packet Edition : Alpha Reborn
description: A nostalgic resource pack bringing back the classic Minecraft App Store era.
body:
# Packet Edition : Alpha Reborn
!["Minecraft : Packet Edition" title screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c20c6e6dfc5322a914e42a5b773a73fa0bc421c7.png)
Back when **Minecraft** first hit the App Store...

**Packet Edition : Alpha Reborn** is a _nostalgic_ resource pack recreating the classic look and feel of early Minecraft. Featuring **_alpha-style fog_**, **_retro textures_**, **_classic sounds_**, and more.

Quick Playthrough Suggestion: Render Distance - 2 Chunks

# Packet Edition — File Description

A nostalgic full-conversion resource pack for Minecraft 1.13-26.1.2, reworking every vanilla texture category into a classic/early-era aesthetic while keeping full compatibility with modern items, blocks, and mobs.

## What's Included

- Wood Types — _Oak Log, Oak Planks, Oak Leaves, Oak Sapling, Oak Trapdoor, Birch Log, Birch Planks, Birch Leaves, Birch Trapdoor, Spruce Log, Spruce Planks, Spruce Leaves, Spruce Trapdoor, Jungle Log, Jungle Planks, Jungle Leaves, Jungle Trapdoor, Acacia Log, Acacia Planks, Acacia Leaves, Acacia Trapdoor, Dark Oak Log, Dark Oak Planks, Dark Oak Leaves, Dark Oak Trapdoor, Crimson Stem, Crimson Planks, Crimson Fungus, Crimson Nylium, Crimson Door, Stripped Crimson Stem, Warped Stem, Warped Planks, Warped Fungus, Warped Nylium, Warped Door, Stripped Warped Stem, Warped Wart Block_
- Boats — _Oak Boat, Birch Boat, Spruce Boat, Jungle Boat, Acacia Boat, Dark Oak Boat_
- Signs — _Oak Sign, Birch Sign, Spruce Sign, Jungle Sign, Acacia Sign, Dark Oak Sign, Crimson Sign, Warped Sign_
- Armor (Player & Horse) — _Chainmail Boots/Chestplate/Helmet/Leggings, Diamond Boots/Chestplate/Helmet/Leggings, Golden Boots/Chestplate/Helmet/Leggings, Iron Boots/Chestplate/Helmet/Leggings, Leather Boots/Chestplate/Helmet/Leggings, Netherite Boots/Chestplate/Helmet/Leggings, Diamond/Iron/Leather Horse Armor, Saddle_
- Tools & Weapons — _Diamond/Golden/Iron/Netherite Axe, Hoe, Pickaxe, Shovel, Sword, Crossbow (+ Arrow & Firework pull frames)_
- Wool — _all 16 colors (Black, Blue, Brown, Cyan, Gray, Green, Light Blue, Light Gray, Lime, Magenta, Orange, Pink, Purple, Red, White, Yellow)_
- Stained Glass — _all 16 colors (same color set as Wool)_
- Beds — _all 16 colors_
- Dyes — _Black, Blue, Brown, White_
-Ores & Mineral Blocks — _Iron Block, Gold Block, Diamond Block, Emerald Block, Lapis Block, Quartz Block, Quartz Bricks, Nether Gold Ore, Nether Quartz Ore, Coal, Charcoal, Gold Ingot, Gold Nugget, Iron Ingot, Diamond, Quartz, Netherite Ingot, Redstone, Glowstone Dust_
- Banner Patterns — _Creeper, Flower, Globe, Mojang, Piglin, Skull_
- Flowers & Plants — _Dandelion, Poppy, Blue Orchid, Allium, Azure Bluet, Red/Orange/White/Pink Tulip, Oxeye Daisy, Cornflower, Lilac, Rose Bush, Peony, Sunflower, Wither Rose, Fern, Large Fern, Tall Grass, Grass, Seagrass, Tall Seagrass, Vine, Sweet Berry Bush, Waterlily, Bamboo (+ leaves/stalk variants), Azalea, Flowering Azalea (+ leaves/plant variants)_
- Food & Potions — _Apple, Golden Apple, Bread, Baked/Poisonous Potato, Cooked Cod/Salmon/Porkchop, Cod, Salmon, Pufferfish, Tropical Fish (+ bucket versions of each), Golden Carrot, Pumpkin Pie, Suspicious Stew, Honey Bottle, Potion, Splash Potion, Warped Fungus on a Stick_
- Functional Blocks & Furniture — _Furnace, Blast Furnace, Smoker, Crafting Table, Smithing Table, Cartography Table, Fletching Table, Barrel, Lectern, Stonecutter, Grindstone, Composter, Respawn Anchor, Dispenser, Spawner, Brewing Stand_
- Nether Theme — _Netherrack, Nether Wart Block, Chiseled/Cracked/Red Nether Bricks, Soul Sand, Soul Soil, Soul Torch, Soul Campfire, Crying Obsidian, Shroomlight_
- Liquids & Sky — _Lava, Water, Clouds, Rain, Snow, Sun_
- Stone & Minerals — _Stone, Cobblestone, Mossy Cobblestone, Stone Slab, Gravel, Sand, Clay, Obsidian, Bedrock, End Stone, Ice, Blue Ice, Moss Block, Podzol, Dirt, Farmland, Grass Block, Grass Path_
-Mobs — _Steve, Alex, Cow, Mooshroom, Pig, Sheep, Chicken, Wolf, Villager, Zombie Villager, Creeper, Zombie, Husk, Zombified Piglin, Skeleton, Stray, Skeleton Horse, Horse, Spider, Silverfish, Enderman, Ghast, Hoglin, Zoglin, Iron Golem, Pillager, Slime, Squid, Strider_
- Particles & Effects — _Explosion, Smoke, Sweep, Spell, Spark, Glitter, Splash, Bubble, Critical Hit, Heart, Flame, Drip (Water & Obsidian), Note, Footprint, Flash, Glint, Enchanted Hit, Standard Galactic Alphabet (the enchanting table glyphs, A–Z)_
- GUI & Menus — _Title Screen Logo, Mojang Logo, Title Screen Panorama, Edition Text, Beacon Screen, Smithing Table Screen, Options Background, Social Interactions Screen, Toast Notifications, Accessibility Icon_
- Status Effects — _Bad Omen, Conduit Power, Dolphin's Grace, Hero of the Village, Instant Damage, Instant Health, Saturation, Slow Falling_
- Other — _Map, Filled Map, Painting, Paper, Flint, Phantom Membrane, Fire Charge, Music Disc (Pigstep), Iron Door, Carved Pumpkin, Pumpkin, Pumpkin/Melon Stem, Potatoes (crop), Sugar Cane, Bricks, Cobweb, Sponge, Wet Sponge, Dragon Egg, Glass, Glowstone, Cactus, Campfire_

## Additional Features

- **Custom Item Models** — Bed colors, grass block, tall grass, large fern, and seagrass route to proper 3D models instead of flat sprites.
- **Custom Particle Behavior** — Obsidian tear drip, fall, and land effects.
- **Full Sound Replacement (141 sounds)** — Classic-style audio for doors, trapdoors, chests, footsteps, mob noises, damage, and liquids.
- **Optifine Support** — Custom entity model for zombified piglins, plus four custom colormaps (alpha green, foliage, grass block, sugar cane) for authentic Alpha/early-Beta color grading.
- **Custom Splash Text** — A unique set of title-screen splash messages.

---

_Some features require OptiFine or EMF+ETF for full experience._
